title: H312 hypothesis seed: Generative AI feature discovery for stock selection
rationale: arXiv:2602.00196 (2026) shows that LLMs with retrieval-augmented generation can automatically discover stock-selection features from analyst reports, options data, and price-volume information — achieving Sharpe improvements of 14–91% over baselines depending on dataset and retrieval quality. Critically, the AI-generated signals are weakly correlated with traditional factors, meaning they can be combined with the existing H198/H217/H228 alpha stack without cancellation. This is a new hypothesis direction (H312) that complements rather than replaces confirmed work. Prerequisites: Polygon options data feed (for options features), EDGAR key (for analyst reports). Not blockable by current data constraints since price-volume alone gives 14% improvement.
content: **H312 PROPOSED** (Generative AI stock selection; arXiv:2602.00196; LLM + RAG feature mining from analyst reports + options data + price-volume → 14-91% Sharpe improvement vs baselines; weakly correlated with H198/H217/H228 alpha signals → stackable; requires EDGAR + Polygon options for full implementation; minimal version uses price-volume only; design gate: OOS Sharpe ≥ 1.20 on 100-stock universe).
